note: Original official-cohort power is not identifiable here: ranking and verified assignment coverage are absent. The structural 2019–2025 holdout has 5,017 scheduled-mapped finals, 306,155 attempt rows and 3,313 broadly eligible solver-seasons. Conditional normal approximations using the unshrunk pilot SE and 4x competition precision give a confirmatory log-SE of 0.0022: essentially zero chance to exceed 1.10 at the pilot effect, 50% power exactly at 1.10, and >99.9% at 1.12. These are sensitivity calculations, not promised power: cohort exposure, dependence, replacement audit and selection change. Structural season eligibility grows about 18x, not 4x.
